name: napkin
title_zh: 每次开工前先读一遍的仓库级运行手册
tagline_zh: 同一仓库反复踩坑？它把散落的经验收敛成优先级排序的十条内清单，每次会话自动激活，开工前先帮你避开已知雷区。
tagline_en: Tired of repeating the same repo mistakes? It condenses hard-won lessons into a priority-sorted top-10 list.
desc_en: Maintain a per-repo napkin as a continuously curated runbook (not a session log). Activates EVERY session. Read and curate it before work, keep only recurring high-value guidance, organize by priority-sorted categories, and cap each category at top 10 items. The napkin lives at `.claude/napkin.md`.
why_zh: 不是日志堆砌，而是持续策展：只留高频高价值指引，按优先级排序且每类封顶十条，逼你不断淘汰过时经验。
why_en: Not a log dump—a curated runbook. It keeps only recurring high-value guidance, priority-sorted, capped at 10 per category.
limit_zh: 只作用于单仓库（.claude/napkin.md），不跨项目同步；它不替你做事，只在你开工前提醒。
limit_en: Per-repo only (.claude/napkin.md), no cross-project sync. It reminds, doesn't execute. Categories exceeding 10 items get truncated—manual pruning.
title_en: A per-repo runbook you read before every session
